name: Karnataka PUC Science Admission
description: Admission to PUC Science streams (PCMB, PCMC, PCME, CBZ, PCMS) is merit-based, using SSLC/10th marks. No entrance exam required. Apply through the college's admission office or Karnataka DPAR online portal.

name: Karnataka PUC Commerce Admission
description: Admission to PUC Commerce streams (SEBA, CEBA, HEBA, BASM) is merit-based, using SSLC marks. No entrance exam required. Apply directly to your chosen Junior College / Pre-University College.

name: Karnataka PUC Arts Admission
description: Admission to PUC Arts streams (HEPS, HEBA, with Psychology, Journalism, etc.) is merit-based using SSLC marks. No entrance exam required. Apply directly to the Junior College of your choice.

name: DTE Karnataka Diploma Admission (Merit-Based)
eligibility: After SSLC / 10th - based on SSLC marks (Mathematics & Science)
description: Admission to Government and Aided Polytechnic / Diploma programmes across Karnataka is merit-based, managed by DTE (Directorate of Technical Education) Karnataka. No separate entrance exam is required for fresh 10th students. Apply at dte.karnataka.gov.in during the admission window.

name: Diploma CET (DCET) - Lateral Entry to BE/BTech
eligibility: After completing 3-Year Polytechnic Diploma (KEA Lateral Entry into 2nd Year BE/B.Tech)
description: DCET (Diploma Common Entrance Test) is conducted by KEA Karnataka for candidates completing a 3-year polytechnic diploma, providing lateral entry directly into the 2nd year (3rd semester) of BE/B.Tech programmes. For fresh 10th students, admission to the diploma programme itself is merit-based via DTE Karnataka.

name: ITI Admission - Karnataka (NCVT / SCVT)
description: Industrial Training Institutes (ITI) offer trade-based vocational training in Electronics, Electrician, Fitter, Turner, Welder, and more. Admission is merit-based on SSLC marks via DTE Karnataka's online admission portal.
